hook: KNRUHS PG university fee jumps *4x* to ₹2 lakh
hook_b: KNRUHS PG university fee jumps *4x* to ₹2 lakh
tldr: Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences hiked university fees for Category B and C postgraduate medical seats weeks before counselling; tuition fees were left unchanged.

beats.what: Category B seat fee went from ₹50,000 to ₹2,00,000 a year; Category C (NRI quota) from ₹70,000 to ₹3,00,000.
beats.why: The university revised institutional, registration and processing fees; government-fixed tuition fees stayed the same.
beats.care: NEET-PG rank holders in Telangana had to arrange extra money close to admission deadlines; HRDA doctors took the issue to the High Court.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 17): aspirants say periodic hikes are common but 300% is not, and asked authorities for 'breathing space'.

cards.q: Should university fees be revised just before counselling?

qs: How much of the new fee can students defer under the High Court order?
Why were fees revised days before counselling?

facts.t: Baseline PG *tuition* fees were *not changed*; only university, registration and processing fees were raised.
